release_notes:
Build 11.3.24 — Windows Test Cleanup

• Explicitly closes SQLite connections in backup and database isolation tests.
• Adds connection cleanup checks that do not rely on garbage collection.
• Includes a dedicated repair test: RUN_FIX_TEST.bat.
• Preserves isolated regression testing, automatic dependency checks and detailed logs.
• Uses UTF-8 encoding for test logs.

Distribution: portable Python source package. No Windows executable included.
Validation: local regression checks passed. Windows acceptance remains incomplete; a Linux restart simulation test requires correction.
